description: Get a Zendesk ticket's selected details and a page of its comments, including available attachments. Comment pagination can be controlled by page and per-page parameters; comment fields and ticket properties may be null.

page.description: Page number for paginating through ticket comments (starts at 1). Zendesk returns up to 100 comments per page by default.
page.human_parameter_description: Which page of comments to retrieve. Start at 1 and increase to browse through more comments on tickets with many replies.
page.title: Page

per_page.description: Number of comments to return per page (max 100). Use with 'page' to control pagination of ticket comments.
per_page.human_parameter_description: How many comments to show on each page. You can choose up to 100.
per_page.title: Per Page

ticket_id.description: ID of the ticket to get details for.
ticket_id.human_parameter_description: The number of the Zendesk ticket you want to view. You can find this ID in the ticket URL or from a ticket list.
ticket_id.title: Ticket Id
